Students who will not meet this requirement should contact their academic advisor to discuss their degree timeline.

courses.title: Guided Elective
courses.choice_note: Catalog lists options as: Guided Elective; or OPRE 4V90. [10] Guided Elective - Students wishing to obtain in-depth knowledge in a specific business area depending on their interests (Concentration A, B, C, or D) or that prefer to follow a General Concentration (E) must choose at least 9 semester credit hours from one of the following tracks. Any remaining Guided Elective hours may be used toward the internship or community engagement requirement. Digital Supply Chain Management Concentration Project Management and Leadership Concentration Analytics Concentration Global Supply Chains and Strategy Concentration General Concentration [11] An Internship (Practicum) of at least 160 working hours is required for all JSOM majors. OPRE 4V90 for credit hours (1-3) can apply towards a free or guided elective if applicable. OPRE 4090 or BA 4090 fulfills degree requirement only. Students who are employed in full-time jobs may fulfill their internship requirement with their current employer as a special project for registration in BA 4090 with preapproval from their program director. Option OPRE 4V90: [11] An Internship (Practicum) of at least 160 working hours is required for all JSOM majors. OPRE 4V90 for credit hours (1-3) can apply towards a free or guided elective if applicable. OPRE 4090 or BA 4090 fulfills degree requirement only. Students who are employed in full-time jobs may fulfill their internship requirement with their current employer as a special project for registration in BA 4090 with preapproval from their program director. [12] OPRE 4090 or BA 4090 is required, if not completing OPRE 4V90 towards a free or guided elective. Students who are employed in full-time jobs may fulfill their internship requirement with their current employer as a special project for registration in BA 4090 with preapproval from their program director.

courses.title: Free Elective
courses.choice_note: [9] Free Elective 3-6 semester credit hours are required for the B.S. in Supply Chain Management. Students who complete MATH 1326 or MATH 2414 or MATH 2419 instead of OPRE 3340 will require 3 semester credit hours (for a total of 6 semester credit hours) of free electives to meet the 120 semester credit hour requirement for graduation. Students who complete OPRE 3340 instead of MATH 1326 or MATH 2414 or MATH 2419 will require an 090 Component Area Option Core course and 3 semester credit hours of free electives to meet the 120 semester credit hour requirement for graduation.
